summary: Native message sends can bind to a stable mission effect key under an attested worker lease. Durable intent, in-flight, confirmation and unresolved receipts recover committed messages by key without repeating origination.

replay.detail: Existing messages and work leases are unchanged; no historical effects are inferred.

schema.detail: Adds the effect subject family and four durable system-only append kinds: effect.intended, effect.in-flight, effect.confirmed and effect.unresolved.

rules.detail: Extends the claim registry and convergence corpus for native effect receipts.

compatibility.detail: MessageSendRequest accepts an optional owner block, omitted when absent. Existing unbound and signed sends retain their wire shape. Effect-bound sends require exact live worker process provenance and lease authority; only the work-claim origin host can originate.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or scheduled downtime.

manual.detail: Ordinary sends require no action. Effect owners opt in through the native message endpoint.

recovery.detail: Interrupted effect sends recover a committed message by key or park with effect-unresolved. Missing local receipts do not permit resend or timeout takeover.
